title: MediaWiki REST API error response (v2, vNext)
description: Error response of modules using version 2.0 of the error format (opt-in via errorSchemaVersion "2.0"; currently only used by content/v2-beta). Additional properties are allowed since handlers may attach extra data.

httpCode.description: The HTTP status code of the error response.

message.description: A human-readable error message, useful when no message translations are available.
examples: The specified page does not exist

messageTranslations.description: A map of language codes to human-readable error messages, for clients that can use them.

examples.en: The specified page does not exist

errorCode.description: A machine-readable code identifying the error. Only present for localized errors.

reqId.description: The ID of the request. Only present for server errors; include it when reporting the error.

exception.description: Structured details of the exception that caused the error. Only present when the wiki is configured to show exception details.

tracing.description: Diagnostic information about the request, useful when reporting the error. Always contains "module", and may contain "request_id", "method", "uri" and "url". The content of this object is not part of the API contract and may change at any time.

module.description: Identifier of the component that served the request.

method.description: Lowercased HTTP method of the request.

uri.description: Path and query of the request.

url.description: Canonical URL of the request, if available.
